mapper.sql: l.link_id, l.bld_id, l.client_uuid, l.sender_user_id, l.author_nm , DATE_FORMAT(l.visited_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') visited_at, l.result, l.resident_status , l.scores, l.factor_check, l.supports, l.memo, l.transcript, l.status, l.record_id, l.ai_summary , l.confirmed_by, DATE_FORMAT(l.confirmed_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') confirmed_at , DATE_FORMAT(l.received_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') received_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM mobile_link_record l WHERE l.client_uuid = #{clientUuid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mobile_link_record (bld_id, client_uuid, sender_user_id, author_nm, visited_at, result, resident_status, scores, factor_check, supports, memo, transcript) VALUES (#{bldId}, #{clientUuid}, #{senderUserId}, #{authorNm}, #{visitedAt}, #{result}, #{residentStatus}, #{scores}, #{factorCheck}, #{supports}, #{memo}, #{transcript})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mobile_link_record WHERE bld_id = #{bldId} AND status = 'NEW'
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MIN(visited_at), '%Y-%m-%d') d_from, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(visited_at), '%Y-%m-%d') d_to FROM mobile_link_record WHERE bld_id = #{bldId} AND status = 'NEW'
SELECT FROM mobile_link_record l WHERE l.bld_id = #{bldId} AND l.status = 'NEW' ORDER BY l.visited_at DESC, l.link_id DESC
SELECT FROM mobile_link_record l WHERE l.link_id = #{linkId}
mapper.update: UPDATE mobile_link_record SET scores = #{scores}, memo = #{memo} WHERE link_id = #{linkId} AND status = 'NEW'
UPDATE mobile_link_record SET transcript = NULL WHERE link_id = #{linkId} AND status = 'NEW'
UPDATE mobile_link_record SET status = 'DONE', record_id = #{recordId}, ai_summary = #{aiSummary}, confirmed_by = #{confirmedBy}, confirmed_at = NOW() WHERE link_id = #{linkId} AND status = 'NEW'
mapper.select: SELECT sp.plan_id FROM survey_plan sp JOIN survey_list sl ON sl.survey_id = sp.survey_id JOIN vulnerability_factor f ON f.factor_id = sp.factor_id WHERE f.bld_id = #{bldId} ORDER BY (sl.user_id = #{userId}) DESC , (sl.user_id = IFNULL(#{senderUserId}, 0)) DESC , sp.plan_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mobile_link_photo (link_id, file_name, label) VALUES (#{linkId}, #{fileName}, #{label})
mapper.select: SELECT p.photo_id, p.link_id, p.file_name, p.label, DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') created_at FROM mobile_link_photo p WHERE p.link_id IN #{id} ORDER BY p.photo_id

SELECT p.photo_id, p.link_id, p.file_name, p.label, l.record_id, DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') created_at FROM mobile_link_photo p JOIN mobile_link_record l ON l.link_id = p.link_id WHERE l.record_id IN #{id} ORDER BY p.photo_id
SELECT p.photo_id, p.link_id, p.file_name, p.label, l.bld_id, l.status, l.record_id FROM mobile_link_photo p JOIN mobile_link_record l ON l.link_id = p.link_id WHERE p.photo_id = #{photoId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mobile_link_photo WHERE link_id = #{linkId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_report (bld_id, user_id, title, format, period_from, period_to, record_cnt, file_name, content) VALUES (#{bldId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{format}, #{periodFrom}, #{periodTo}, #{recordCnt}, #{fileName}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT report_id, bld_id, user_id, title, format, file_name FROM ai_report WHERE report_id = #{reportId}
